name: USGS Network Linked Data Index (NLDI)
waters_covered: CONUS NHDPlus V2 network; all New England rivers
access_detail: GET /comid/position?coords=POINT(lon lat); /hydrolocation?coords=...; /{source}/{id}/navigation/{UM|UT|DM|DD}/flowlines?distance=km&trimStart=true; /{source}/{id}/navigation/DM/{nwissite|npdes|WQP|...}?distance=km; /{source}/{id}/basin. No key. Header x-ratelimit-limit: 3600. Old base labs.waterdata.usgs.gov/api/nldi returns 404. API version 3.0.4 (docs/openapi.json).
cannot_fill: waterbody name (only GNIS via other services)
cadence: static network (NHDPlus V2); linked sources refreshed periodically
license: USGS public domain (no licence text returned by the API)
status_reason: Works today for the Connecticut River at Springfield; snaps points and outfalls to NHDPlus V2 and traces downstream with distance caps.
notes: Flowlines carry only COMID; get lengths/velocities from EPA NHDPlus MapServer.

name: EPA reach-indexed NPDES outfalls (Internet of Water / geoconnex features server; NLDI 'npdes' source)
operator: Internet of Water Coalition / geoconnex, from EPA data
waters_covered: national; 466 points in the Springfield/Holyoke/Chicopee bbox
access_detail: OGC API Features: /collections/NPDES/items?bbox=minx,miny,maxx,maxy&f=json&limit=1000 ; /items/{permit+outfall}. Also via NLDI /linked-data/npdes/{id}. Collection cites HydroShare resource 495b65e56e994289baaa5feeb401358e NPDES_pts.gpkg as data source.
license: Not stated on collection; EPA source data public domain
status_reason: Gives outfall-level COMID and reach measure for SWSC (MA0101613xxx), Holyoke (MA0101630xxx), Chicopee (MA0101508xxx).
notes: Missing SWSC 001 and 015A/015B (404). MA0103331 present at 42.09982,-72.59612; identity to be confirmed by state agent.

name: EPA NHDPlus V2.1 MapServer (Network Flowline layer, VAA + EROM attributes)
access_detail: query?where=comid in (...)&outFields=comid,gnis_name,lengthkm,totdasqkm,slope,qe_ma,ve_ma,ve_07,tidal,...&returnGeometry=false&f=json. No key.
status_reason: Per-reach length, drainage area, slope, EROM mean/monthly flow and velocity, and a tidal flag for the traced path.
notes: tidal=1 and ve_ma=-9999 from COMID 7700934 (near Windsor CT) downstream.

name: EPA WATERS services (api.epa.gov/waters: navigation3, upstreamdownstream v4, pointindexing v3, drainageareadelineation, eventindexing)
access_detail: OpenAPI at https://api.epa.gov/waters/oas30; viewer https://watersgeo.epa.gov/openapi/waters/. Requires api.data.gov key: 'All production usage requires a registered key.' Three probes with the public DEMO_KEY returned validation messages only; no full navigation run.

navigation_probe.status_message: Valid navigation type codes are UM, UT, DM, DD, and PP.

license: OpenAPI info.license: 'Creative Commons Zero Public Domain Dedication' (https://edg.epa.gov/epa_data_license.html)
status_reason: Navigation can stop by flow time (search_max_flowtimeday) and index at NHDPlus HR; but needs a registered key the owner must request.

name: EPA WATERS legacy Point Indexing service (ofmpub waters10)
access_detail: ?pGeometry=POINT(-72.59 42.10)&pGeometryMod=WKT,SRSNAME=urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC::CRS84&pPointIndexingMethod=DISTANCE&pPointIndexingMaxDist=25&pOutputPathFlag=TRUE&optOutFormat=JSON. No key.
status_reason: Works without a key but is a legacy endpoint whose siblings are gone.

name: EPA WATERS legacy UpstreamDownstream / Navigation / NavigationDelineation services (ofmpub waters10)
access_detail: Returned ORDS-22001 'The procedure named UpstreamDownstream.Service could not be accessed or found' (same for Navigation.Service, NavigationDelineation.Service, UpstreamDownstreamV3.Service).
status_reason: Not available; replaced by api.epa.gov/waters.

name: NHDPlus Version 2 (medium resolution) dataset
access_detail: Used through NLDI, EPA MapServer, NWM and NWPS (reach ids = COMIDs).
status_reason: The common reach identifier across NLDI, NWM v3.1 and NWPS today.
notes: NCO NWM inventory: 'feature_id Reach ID - NHDPlusv2 ComIDs within CONUS'.

name: NHDPlus High Resolution
access_detail: Static product; USGS describes NHD and NHDPlus HR as 'bridge datasets' while 3DHP is built.
status_reason: Better geometry but not used by NLDI/NWM/NWPS; EPA WATERS can index to an HR snapshot.

name: National Hydrography Dataset (NHD)
access_detail: Page: 'As of October 1, 2023, the NHD was retired. NHD data will continue to be available, but no longer maintained. The most current data will be available through the 3D Hydrography Program (3DHP).'

name: 3D Hydrography Program (3DHP)
access_detail: Replacement for NHD, WBD and NHDPlus HR; no New England production coverage confirmed this run.
status_reason: Future network; none of the services we use are on it yet.

name: USGS Water Data OGC API (latest-continuous, continuous, daily, monitoring-locations, time-series-metadata)
access_detail: latest-continuous/items?f=json&state_code=25&limit=10000&skipGeometry=true&properties=monitoring_location_id,parameter_code,time,value,unit_of_measure (one call per state, 2-13 s). monitoring-locations/items?state_code=25&site_type_code=ST. daily/items?monitoring_location_id=USGS-01184000&parameter_code=00060&statistic_id=00003&datetime=... v0 and v1 both serve. A key sign-up page exists (/signup/); not used.
license: USGS public domain (no licence text on landing page)
status_reason: Real-time discharge, stage and water quality for New England gauges; replaces WaterServices.
notes: No current mainstem Connecticut River gauge at Springfield or Northampton.

name: USGS legacy WaterServices (waterservices.usgs.gov)
access_detail: GovDelivery bulletin 2026-09-17: degradation from November 2026, planned outages January 2027, 'will be decommissioned on February 22, 2027'.
status_reason: Being decommissioned 2027-02-22; do not build on it.

name: USGS water data announcements (GovDelivery bulletin 42b03d7)
access_detail: Bulletin sent 09/17/2026; email subscription available (owner to subscribe).
status_reason: Source of decommission dates; subscribe for changes.

name: NOAA National Water Prediction Service API (reaches, gauges, stageflow)
access_detail: /reaches/{COMID}; /reaches/{COMID}/streamflow?series=analysis_assimilation|short_range|medium_range|long_range; /gauges/{LID}; /gauges/{LID}/stageflow. No key.
cadence: hourly analysis; forecasts per NWM cycle
license: Not stated in API responses; NOAA data generally public domain
status_reason: NWM flow on every NHDPlus reach plus NWS gauge flood categories; no velocity.

name: National Water Model channel_rt output (velocity, streamflow per COMID) on AWS noaa-nwm-pds / NOMADS
operator: NOAA Office of Water Prediction / NCEP
access_detail: S3 listing works (nwm.20261101/analysis_assim/nwm.t12z.analysis_assim.channel_rt.tm00.conus.nc, 12,488,145 bytes). NCO inventory lists 'velocity River Velocity m s-1' and 'feature_id Reach ID - NHDPlusv2 ComIDs within CONUS'. Needs netCDF/HDF5 reader; not downloaded.
license: NOAA open data (AWS Open Data registry)
status_reason: Only modeled velocity on every reach; heavy to process; model output not observation.

name: NOAA NWM Stream Analysis map service
access_detail: Fields: objectid, stream_order, tile_id, flow_category, local_flow_category, shape, cg_valid_time, cg_ingest_time. Query by feature_id failed (400).
license: 'Source: NWS Office of Water Prediction. Public domain'
status_reason: No feature_id or velocity; display only.

name: NWS Service Change Notice 26-64 (Updated): NWM v3.1
access_detail: Dated 1130 AM EDT Thu Jul 30 2026; 'Effective on or about August 18th, 2026'. Copy in raw/pdf/.
status_reason: Establishes the operational NWM version and file layout.

name: NCO NWM product inventory pages
access_detail: Inventory of nwm.t00z.analysis_assim.channel_rt.tm00.conus.nc and short_range: velocity m s-1; page 'Last Updated: Mon Feb 5 19:53:59 2018'.
status_reason: Confirms velocity variable and COMID ids.

name: USGS StreamStats SS-Delineate
access_detail: GET /ss-delineate/v1/delineate/features/MA?lat=42.0935&lon=-72.5698 returned pourpoint, split_catchment (9.49 km2) and adjoint_catchment features. 'Limit service queries to no more than four simultaneous requests.'
status_reason: Drainage area for small ungauged tributary outfalls; mainstem handled by NHDPlus.

name: USGS StreamStats legacy services (streamstatsservices)
access_detail: Notice: 'These legacy services will be discontinued on January 30, 2026.' watershed.geojson returned 404 today.
status_reason: Discontinued.

name: USGS StreamStats SS-Hydro
access_detail: openapi.json returned HTTP 502 today.
status_reason: 502 on 2026-11-01; retry later.

name: Jobson 1996, Prediction of traveltime and longitudinal dispersion in rivers and streams (USGS WRIR 96-4013)
status_reason: Travel-time method with published error when no local dye study exists.

name: Smith 2002, Travel times and dispersion of soluble dye in thirteen New Hampshire rivers (OFR 2002-226)
access_detail: Abstract fetched: velocities 0.03-2.4 ft/s; 6-hour travel distance at mean annual flood 5.8-43 mi; includes a Connecticut River reach in NH (injection 43 07'30"N 72 26'15"W). Full PDF is 29 MB scanned; not retained.
status_reason: Only a NH reach of the Connecticut; useful check on Jobson.

name: Parker 2006, Time of travel and dispersion in the Merrimack River in Massachusetts from the state line to the Atlantic Ocean (SIR 2006-5103)
access_detail: 'Available by request only' from MassDEP Division of Watershed Management, Worcester.
status_reason: Local calibration for Merrimack traces; must be requested.

name: Parker and others 2011, Time of travel and dispersion of a dye plume in the Blackstone River, MA and RI, 2009 (OFR 2011-1284)
access_detail: Landing page fetched; online at https://doi.org/10.3133/ofr20111284; results not read.
status_reason: Local calibration for Blackstone traces.

name: Older New England time-of-travel studies cited by Jobson (Dunn 1965 Hoosic; Cervione 1972 Quinnipiac; Nichols et al. 1981 Little Androscoggin; Parker 1980 Presumpscot; Parker 1981 Sebasticook; Parker & Hunt 1983 lower Androscoggin; Parker et al. 1983 Androscoggin basin WRI 83-4232)
access_detail: Citations read in Jobson appendices; reports not fetched.
status_reason: Possible calibration for those rivers.

name: US Army Corps of Engineers 2025 Connecticut River dye tests (hydrilla treatment)
access_detail: News report: dye tests at Chester Creek, Hamburg Cove, Portland Boat Works and Agawam MA. No travel-time data found.
status_reason: Could hold local dispersion data; ask USACE.

name: USGS time-of-travel study, Connecticut River Holyoke-Springfield-Hartford
access_detail: USGS Publications Warehouse search returned no such study.
status_reason: None found.

name: NWS API station observations (ASOS)
access_detail: User-Agent header required. KCEF latest was 2026-10-31T23:55Z at fetch (18 h old), precipitationLastHour null.
status_reason: Rain context near outfalls; stale observations possible.

name: NWS API gridpoint quantitative precipitation forecast
access_detail: points/42.10,-72.59 -> BOX 22,80; quantitativePrecipitation hourly values in mm; updateTime 2026-11-01T18:01:42Z.
status_reason: 'Rain expected' context; never a discharge claim.

name: Iowa Environmental Mesonet ASOS download service
access_detail: ?station=BDL&station=CEF&data=p01i&year1=2026&month1=10&day1=30&...&format=onlycomma returned station,valid,p01i rows.
status_reason: Easy hourly precipitation history for event context.

name: NOAA MRMS QPE ImageServer (radar-only QPE 1-72 h)
access_detail: identify?geometry={x,y,wkid 4326}&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&returnCatalogItems=true&f=json returned 7 values (1,3,6,12,24,48,72 h, inches) with idp_validendtime. 'Usually by 0:04 after the hour.'
status_reason: Rain at the outfall without GRIB decoding.

name: MRMS GRIB2 products on AWS (noaa-mrms-pds)
access_detail: CONUS/MultiSensor_QPE_24H_Pass2_00.00/20261101/... grib2.gz about 4.25 MB.
status_reason: Needs a GRIB2 decoder; use the ImageServer instead for the pilot.

name: NOAA CO-OPS Tides and Currents API (South Hartford 8464418, New London 8461490)
access_detail: mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/8464418.json: SOUTH HARTFORD, CONNECTICUT RIVER, tidal true. datagetter?station=8464418&product=predictions&datum=MLLW&interval=hilo&date=today returned 4 predictions.
status_reason: Marks tidal reaches and tide state for labels in tidal water.

name: NOAA Operational Forecast Systems (GoMOFS, NYOFS)
access_detail: Models page lists GoMOFS and NYOFS for the region; no Narragansett Bay, Long Island Sound or Lake Champlain system listed.
status_reason: Circulation models exist for some bays but no program uses them for sewage advisories.

name: Northeast Coastal Ocean Forecast System (NECOFS, UMass Dartmouth FVCOM)
access_detail: Includes a Boston Harbor mesh and Mass coastal FVCOM; not fetched in detail.
status_reason: Research-grade harbor circulation; not for the pilot.

name: US Census TIGERweb State_County MapServer
access_detail: query where STATE='25' with envelope; returned MA polygon; used to find the river's state-line crossing (42.0311,-72.6082).
status_reason: State line for the worked example.

name: openboatlaunch launch records: gauge, tide_station, facts.tidal, water link
url: openboatlaunch out/launch/ (the sibling project's local export; no public URL)
access_detail: Each launch JSON has gauge {id, name, km, params, nwps}, tide_station {id, name, km}, facts.tidal, water {slug}. Example: kings-island launch gauge 01184000 (TMVC3, 2.7 km).
status_reason: Already links launches to gauges and tide stations; no COMIDs yet.
notes: Charter Oak Landing is linked to park-river-ct but NHD snaps it to the Connecticut River mainstem.

name: Massachusetts 314 CMR 16.00 Notification Requirements to Promote Public Awareness of Sewage Pollution
access_detail: Sections 16.02, 16.04, 16.05, 16.06, 16.09 read on Cornell LII.
status_reason: Defines what a notice must name: 'Waters and land areas, including names of water bodies and municipalities, affected or potentially affected' (16.04(10)(f)); 'Avoid contact with these water bodies for 48 hours after the discharge or overflow ceases' (16.04(10)(g)); recipients in 'any municipality directly impacted' (16.04(4)(a)). No definition of affected/downstream.

name: New York ECL 17-0826-a (Sewage Pollution Right to Know)
access_detail: Notify 'the chief elected official or their authorized designee of any adjoining municipality that may be affected'; health departments within two hours, public within four hours.
status_reason: Comparison wording for 'affected'.

name: Michigan MCL 324.3112a sewage discharge notification
access_detail: Search snippet: notice to the local health department and municipalities whose waters may be affected.
status_reason: Comparison; not read in full.

name: King County CSO status map
access_detail: Snippets: 'Stay out of the water near combined sewer overflow outfalls for 48 hours after a combined sewer overflow occurs'; map 'updated every 10 minutes'.
status_reason: Prior art: outfall-proximity plus 48 h, no distance.

name: ALCOSAN sewer overflow advisories (orange CSO flags)
access_detail: Snippets: flags at designated marinas/clubs; lowered 'After 48 hours without additional overflow'; season April 1-October 31.
status_reason: Prior art: site flags, 48 h.

name: Charles River Watershed Association flagging program
access_detail: Snippets from 2022 report: 'red flags are flown at all locations for 48 hours following a CSO'; statistical model using precipitation; 630 cfu/100mL threshold.
status_reason: Local prior art for rainfall and 48 h rules.

name: Connecticut River Conservancy, Bacteria monitoring and sewer overflows (2025-08-20)
access_detail: Wet weather = significant rain in prior 24-96 h; CSO volume in ~48 h before sampling; small CSOs in drought year 2024 mattered more than large ones in flood year 2023; Holyoke-Chicopee-Springfield stretch highest E. coli; no downstream distance given.
status_reason: Only local analysis linking CSOs and bacteria on this reach.

name: CT DEEP release: water quality impacts following heavy rainfall (2026-07-07)
access_detail: 'During and within 48-72 hrs of rain events, the Connecticut River and the Long Island Sound may see elevated health risk.' Names Chicopee, Holyoke, Springfield and Hartford MDC CSOs. No inch threshold.
status_reason: State wording for rain-related risk window.

name: RI DEM conditional shellfish area rainfall closures (Upper Narragansett Bay)
access_detail: Snippets (2015-2016): seven-day closures after 0.5 in (Conimicut Triangle), 0.8 in (Area A), 1.5 in (Area B); earlier 0.5/1.0 in.
status_reason: Example of a rainfall-triggered closure rule; current values unconfirmed.

name: NYC Health beach wet-weather advisories
access_detail: Snippets: 12 h advisory after 1.5-2.5 in and 24 h after >2.5 in at listed beaches.
status_reason: Rainfall-threshold prior art.

name: Beachwatch NSW pollution forecasts
access_detail: Snippets: rainfall data used to predict likelihood of bacterial contamination; 'Pollution likely' advice.
status_reason: Rainfall-forecast prior art; thresholds not found.

name: Swim Guide (Swim Drink Fish) rainfall-based advisories
access_detail: Not researched this run.
status_reason: Known prior art; rainfall rules not verified.

name: Surfers Against Sewage Safer Seas & Rivers Service
access_detail: Snippets: alert text 'Storm sewage has been discharged from a sewer overflow in this location within the past 48 hours'; data from water companies' EDM sensors.
status_reason: Prior art for 48 h alert wording.

name: Thames Water storm discharge map (EDM)
access_detail: Snippets: red ongoing, orange stopped within 48 hours; 'can take up to 4 days for the sewage to clear'; map 'shouldn't be used to determine water quality'.
status_reason: Prior art for labelling and caveats.

name: Water UK / Stream National Storm Overflows Hub
access_detail: Launched November 2024; near real-time data for ~14,000 overflows; API; CC-BY per sewagemap README.
status_reason: UK reference for a national near-real-time feed.

name: sewagemap.co.uk and AlexLipp/sewage-map (downstream impact of CSO discharges)
operator: Alex Lipp, Jonny Dawe, Sudhir Balaji
access_detail: README fetched (raw/web/sewage-map-README.md): 'Realtime mapping the downstream impact of Combined Sewage Overflow discharge events in non-tidal rivers'; uses POOPy package and Stream hub (CC-BY), Thames and Scottish Water APIs; GPL-3.0.
status_reason: Closest prior art to our modeled reach layer; confirms the non-tidal stop rule.

name: USGS Publications Warehouse API
access_detail: ?q=time%20of%20travel%20Merrimack etc.
status_reason: Literature search for New England travel-time studies.
